             9.2
                    Choose the correct collocation.
                        She had / took / paid attention to what | told her and started working harder.

                        | got / made / had a bad dream last night and woke up sweating.

                        | gave /made /had a feeling | had met Richard before, but | couldn’t remember where.
                        | went to Douglas Farnham’s funeral to give / take / pay my last respects to a fine man.
